limitations: Missing BiI3_SiO2_800 wall-temperature profile in supplied paper.
Figure 7C plotted temperature differs from printed PbI2/BiI3 peak labels by about 63/108 K.
Flow reference, coordinate origin, boat geometry/placement and release histories unconfirmed.
Diffusivity 1e-4 m2/s and unit accommodation are provisional.
Q1 LBE splits are conditioned on measured deposited amounts; they are not independent split predictions.
Q2 +29 kJ/mol BiI sensitivity is a surrogate, not a second qualified dataset.
KI is excluded explicitly; no histogram renormalisation to 100%.
Full-size 60 s / 2 ms matrix and mesh/time-step convergence remain unrun.
One coarse silica Q1 stationarity diagnostic is NOT_QUALIFIED due to very small metal deposition.
Peak agreement alone does not qualify experimental validation; profile shape mismatches remain substantial.
